categories.main_business_segments: The company operates three primary business segments: (1) Water pollution treatment equipment - standardized, modular FMBR-based devices for wastewater treatment; (2) Water environment comprehensive solutions - integrated design, procurement, construction, and commissioning services for water treatment projects; (3) Water pollution treatment project operations - professional operation and maintenance services for wastewater treatment facilities using BOT, BOO, and O&M models.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technology is the FMBR (Facultative Membrane Bio-Reactor) wastewater treatment process, developed through integration of microbiology, fluid mechanics, and mechatronics. Key technologies include: carbon-nitrogen-phosphorus simultaneous deep removal, sludge source reduction, high-efficiency composite aeration, and high-efficiency membrane system regeneration. Additionally, the company developed JDL heavy metal wastewater treatment technology. Manufacturing uses 'production-to-order' combined with market forecasting, with standardized production in workshops and on-site system integration for projects.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are government agencies, state-owned enterprises, and municipal authorities. Main markets include: village and town wastewater treatment (leading market position), municipal wastewater treatment, black odorous water body remediation, and industrial wastewater treatment. The company serves customers across 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in China, plus international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with presence in 30 provinces, autonomous regions, and direct-controlled municipalities. International operations include subsidiaries in Colorado and New York, USA. Main production bases are located in Xinyu and Yixing. Domestic revenue represents 100% of current period revenue, with international market development ongoing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream (equipment and component manufacturing), midstream (system integration and project implementation), and downstream (project operation and maintenance services). The company integrates the full value chain from equipment manufacturing through long-term operational services, positioning itself as a comprehensive water environment treatment service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) Science and technology-driven enterprise strategy - deepening FMBR mechanism research and optimizing core processes; (2) Market diversification strategy - expanding from village/town markets to municipal and black water body treatment; (3) Globalization strategy - increasing international patent applications and overseas market expansion. R&D focuses on resource utilization, ultra-low energy consumption, high-quality effluent treatment, and intelligent remote monitoring systems. The company has 21 ongoing research projects with 9.03% of revenue invested in R&D.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue through three primary channels: (1) Direct sales of standardized water treatment equipment to end customers; (2) Engineering contracts for comprehensive water environment solutions including design, procurement, construction, and commissioning; (3) Project operation services under BOT, BOO, and O&M models with recurring revenue streams. Revenue is primarily generated through public bidding, single-source procurement, competitive negotiation, and agreement-based procurement methods.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading innovator in village/town wastewater treatment, ranked among top market share holders in this segment. It competes against traditional wastewater treatment technology providers and increasingly against large state-owned enterprises and central enterprises entering the environmental protection sector. The company differentiates through proprietary FMBR technology, distributed treatment model, and comprehensive service capabilities. It holds status as a national-level specialized and sophisticated 'little giant' enterprise and national intellectual property advantage enterprise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized environmental protection enterprise with 2023 revenue of 505.2 million RMB (down 36.13% from 791.0 million in 2022), net profit of 183.1 million RMB (down 39.73% from 303.7 million in 2022). Total assets of 3.50 billion RMB as of end-2023. The company experienced revenue decline in 2023 due to cautious operating strategy and reduced project intake amid challenging external market conditions, though operating cash flow improved significantly to 304.7 million RMB (up 169.54%).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's key differentiators include: (1) Proprietary FMBR technology offering superior effluent quality, 70%+ sludge reduction, and lower operating costs; (2) Distributed water treatment model enabling decentralized, near-source treatment suitable for scattered pollution sources; (3) Standardized, modular equipment enabling rapid deployment and flexible scaling; (4) Intelligent, unmanned operation systems reducing labor costs and improving reliability; (5) Comprehensive service integration from equipment supply through long-term operations; (6) Demonstrated track record with multiple international awards and recognition as leading village/town wastewater treatment provider.
